scenario_description:
Objective: Keep the Feb 12 Extraction Cache skirmish usable by ensuring the required cache-marker set is available before game night.
Emerging Need: Store updates turn the future scenario from ordinary packing into one that requires six numbered 25mm markers; terrain notes determine whether existing supplies satisfy it.
Decision Context: Loaner sets cannot be claimed until the terrain volunteer opens reservations, then the packing cutoff leaves only a short window for a reversible hold.
Consequence: If the reservation window passes without a compliant set secured, the game remains scheduled but the prerequisite cannot be met through store loaners.

parameter.title: Extraction Cache casual skirmish
parameter.description: Four-player narrative skirmish; final terrain packet to follow after table count.

parameter.subject: Extraction Cache terrain packet timing
parameter.body: The Feb 12 terrain addendum is still pending while table count settles. Please hold off on loaner objective-kit questions for now; extras will not be assigned until the scenario packet is final.

parameter.subject: Extraction Cache marker requirements
parameter.body: Final packet note for Feb 12: each player needs six numbered cache markers with an approximately 25mm footprint. Unnumbered or oversized crate tokens may confuse hidden-cache calls. A few store loaner sets exist; reservation details will come from the terrain volunteer after inventory.

parameter.content: I finished inventorying store terrain for Feb 12. Loaner numbered 25mm cache-marker sets can be tagged by player name until Sunday Feb 8 at 8 PM; after that the terrain boxes are sealed for transport.

parameter.subject: Terrain boxes sealed for Feb 12
parameter.body: Loaner cache-marker reservations closed last night. The packed boxes contain only sets already tagged by name; unreserved players should arrive with their own compliant numbered 25mm markers.
